rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday term for a period of physical exercise.

example.english: I did a half-hour workout this morning.
example.traditional: 我朝早做咗半個鐘運動。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 zou6 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1 wan6 dung6

rows.note: Use this for a demanding gym, sports, or fitness training session rather than casual exercise.

example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 fan6 cou1 zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this for a structured exercise or athletic training program with planned exercises.

example.english: The coach made me a workout plan to prepare for next month's marathon.
example.traditional: 教練幫我訂咗一個訓練計劃，準備下個月嘅馬拉松。
example.jyutping: gaau3 lin6 bong1 ngo5 deng6 zo2 jat1 go3 fan3 lin6 gai3 waak6 zeon2 bei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 ge3 maa5 laai1 sung1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a fitness or bodybuilding program aimed at improving the body.

example.english: I followed this workout plan for three months and got much fitter.
example.traditional: 我跟住呢個健身計劃操咗三個月，身形好咗好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gan1 zyu6 ni1 go3 gin6 san1 gai3 waak6 cou1 zo2 saam1 go3 jyut6 san1 jing4 hou2 zo2 hou2 do1
